title: Record the rank-7 hyperplane count
body:
## Summary
- Every 7-dimensional subspace of `F_2^9` has a 128-point orthogonal and an annihilator of size 4, so it lies in exactly 3 hyperplanes.
- There are 43,435 such subspaces, and each of the 511 hyperplanes contains 255 of them. The incidence identity is `43435 * 3 = 511 * 255`.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged.
